---
title: "tiltedTMLE analysis report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
params:
  main: NULL
  boot: NULL
  script: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
main <- params$main
boot <- params$boot
s <- summary_text(main, boot)
```

This report contains summary results only; it does not include any individual-level data.

## Summary

`r s$sentence`

```{r caveats, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", s$caveats), sep = "\n")
```

## Settings

```{r settings, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", main$spec_description), sep = "\n")
```

## Estimates

```{r estimates}
knitr::kable(results_table(main, boot), digits = 4, na = "")
```

```{r estimator-plot}
plot_estimators(main, boot)
```

## Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
knitr::kable(diagnostics_table(main))
```

```{r overlap}
plot_overlap(main)
```

```{r weights}
plot_weights(main)
```

```{r notes, results = "asis"}
notes <- c(main$warnings,
           if (!is.null(boot) && !inherits(boot, "run_error"))
             paste0("Bootstrap: ", boot$n_failed, " failed and ", boot$n_nonconverged,
                    " non-converged resample(s) of ", length(boot$estimates), "."))
if (length(notes) > 0) cat("## Warnings and notes\n\n", paste0("- ", notes), sep = "\n")
```

## Reproduce

```{r script, results = "asis"}
cat("```r\n", params$script, "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

Package version: `r main$package_version`; `r main$r_version`.
